ropoll_claim.text: RoPoLL dominates PoLL on every biased corruption type: by ≈19%\approx 19\% on cross-dimensional attacks at matched compute, and by orders of magnitude on heavy-tailed Byzantine adversaries (whose unbounded first moments make any breakdown-positive aggregator beat averaging unconditionally).

ropoll_unbounded.text: PoLL incurs unbounded bias under any positive contamination, regardless of jury size, whenever a single judge fails in a biased, LLM-typical way (mode collapse, sycophancy, safety refusal).
